description: 20 mime illustrator cues: 10 object depiction + 10 profession depiction.

object.prompt_line: Raise the arm upward and spread the hand open like branches growing from a trunk.
Form a large curved shape in front of the chest with one sweeping arc, cupping empty space.
Cup the hand into a small sphere shape and hold it steady in front of the body.
Trace a square or rectangle in the air with flat palm edges.
Hold the palm horizontal and draw a wide flat circle, like presenting a dinner plate.
Draw a narrow vertical silhouette with an up-down stroke, like a bottle.
Raise the arm overhead and open the palm outward like an umbrella canopy.
Make a short downward striking beat with a closed hand, like hammering a nail.
Extend the arm forward, then flick the wrist upward like casting a fishing line.
Bring the hand to eye level in a tube shape and push forward slightly, like looking through a telescope.

profession.prompt_line: Sweep the hand side to side in front of the body, like brushing paint on a wall.
Make small circular stirring motions over an imaginary pot.
Beat the hand up and down rhythmically in front of the chest, like conducting music.
Write short lines in the air with the index finger, like chalk on a board.
Frame an imaginary shot: one hand square, slight forward lean.
Tilt the hand downward and make a light pouring motion, like watering plants.
Short repeated wrist turns, like tightening a bolt with a wrench.
Open and close the fingers in small snips near head level.
Slide the hand left-right across an imaginary turntable at waist height.
Pull the arm back near the shoulder, then release forward, like drawing a bow.
